trigger.message: Reconnecting... 1/5 (stream disconnected before completion: Transport error: network error: error decoding response body)

timing: Recorded before any revision-v3 LLM classification score. The failed initial freeze did not read evaluation labels.
purpose: Pre-score verifier correction distinguishes one explicitly logged recovered network-stream reconnect from fatal or unknown diagnostic errors. This is not a change to predictions, the original inference runner, model settings, prompts, or the frozen experimental protocol.
acceptance: Only the exact top-level error event specified by the trigger is eligible. The same CLI session must subsequently emit a complete, schema-valid and ID-complete final response followed by turn.completed; raw output, saved predictions, event text, and metadata.errors must agree. Tool events remain forbidden.
transport_budget: For every model/group, the number of CLI attempts plus the number of logged internal stream reconnections must not exceed two. Thus one CLI attempt plus one recovered reconnect exhausts the existing transport budget.
fatal_cases: Unknown errors, turn.failed, item-level diagnostic errors, missing or invalid final output, missing turn.completed, extra reconnections, metadata mismatches, and semantic retries still fail closed.
reporting: Retain the original diagnostic_errors_count and record recovered_stream_reconnections with event details. A recovered reconnect is not described as zero diagnostic errors or as a new independent experimental session.
